title: Zhongtong N12 Trolleybuses Delivered to Mexico City
summary: A batch of Zhongtong N12 dual-source trolleybuses was delivered to Mexico City, upgrading local public transport capacity and providing green mobility guarantees for the 2026 World Cup.
content:
On March 9, 2026, the departure ceremony for a batch of Zhongtong N12 dual-source trolleybuses being delivered to Mexico was successfully held. This fleet will travel across the ocean to reach the Mexican capital, Mexico City. The delivery aims to further refine the local public transport capacity structure and enhance the quality of daily travel for citizens. Simultaneously, these vehicles will provide green mobility guarantees for the 2026 World Cup, assisting in the comprehensive upgrade of local public transportation.

## Escorting the 2026 World Cup! Batch Delivery of Zhongtong N12 Dual-Source Trolleybuses to Mexico City

As the capital of Mexico, Mexico City experiences high daily passenger flows and intense operational demands, placing strict requirements on vehicle reliability, comfort, and environmental friendliness. With the continuous upgrading of urban public transport, stable, high-efficiency, and low-carbon buses have become an essential need for citizen travel.

It is reported that this batch of vehicles consists of models customized by Zhongtong Bus specifically for the Mexican transit scene. The specially optimized body structure perfectly adapts to high-intensity local operational needs, and the vehicles are equipped with intelligent safety warning systems to comprehensively enhance operational safety. Meanwhile, the vehicles offer the advantages of zero emissions and low noise, perfectly aligning with the local direction of green transportation development.

Furthermore, as the 2026 World Cup approaches, Mexico City will welcome a massive influx of global football fans. This fleet will simultaneously undertake transportation guarantee tasks during the tournament.

As a model selected for a repeat purchase by Mexico, the Zhongtong N12 dual-source trolleybus has gained market recognition through its stable operational performance. At the event, a Mexican client stated in an interview: "Our choice of Zhongtong Bus is primarily due to its excellent product quality, comprehensive after-sales service support, and strong order delivery capabilities."

The delivery of this fleet will provide convenient, safe, and green transportation services for Mexico City and global fans during the World Cup, injecting new momentum into the development of Mexican public transport and letting the presence of Chinese buses shine on the international stage.
